description: Windows Dynamic Notch with media controls, system HUDs, file shelf, terminal, agent integrations, widgets, and plugins.
notes: The publisher's installer/build.ps1 defines a custom appended-payload format: [setup executable][ZIP payload][8-byte ZIP length][NOTCHPAY]. The Scoop installer script extracts that embedded ZIP and verifies Notch.exe without running the publisher's registration/setup routine. The extraction script must be exercised on Windows before this manifest is considered fully verified.

The upstream setup normally registers a per-user uninstall entry, notch:// protocol, PATH entry, shortcuts, and startup behavior. Those setup-time registrations are intentionally not created by this portable Scoop extraction.
Settings are stored under %APPDATA%\\Notch. The application's update notices remain enabled; updates require explicit user action in the app.
